Hook Builder

Configure a hook visually → get the settings.json snippet

Quick Presets

When should this hook fire?

Hook receives event JSON on stdin. Exit codes:

exit 0 = Allowexit 2 = Block (write reason to stderr)other = Allow + log error
.claude/settings.json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs npx prettier --write"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
To apply: merge this into .claude/settings.json. Then run /hooks in Claude Code to reload.
